newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - Nov 11.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - Nov 11.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bangladesh press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina leaves Thursday for Rome to lead the Bangladesh delegation to the World Food summit due in the Italian capital November 15-17.
The treasury bench on Sunday placed the Indemnity (repeal) Bill in parliament seeking to pave the way for trial of the killers of independence leader Shiekh Mujibur Rahman.

At least 50 students fell sick after taking food which they cooked while on a picnic trip to the historic Sonargaon village near capital Dhaka on Sunday. Poisoned students were sent to diarrhoeal hospital.

Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina told parliament on Sunday that her government was following the policy of "economic diplomacy" and asked missions abroad to try aggressively to attract foreign investment.
Finance Minister S A M S Kibria on Sunday said the industries should increase wages of workers to boost productivity.
The government has allowed export oriented industries to sell up to 20 percent of their total production, only if found unsuitable for export, in the local market after paying duties and taxes.
